written: 2026-11-24, before any model was trained on this dataset
data: dev users only (config/cv_folds.csv: 5 folds x 3 repeats, schedule-grouped); the test part plays no role

rule_A_algorithm.metric_primary: row recall@1%fpr on the model's own label y_h (reference negatives = benign-user rows), mean over the 15 folds, then averaged over h = 5, 10, 20
rule_A_algorithm.metric_guard: row PR-AUC on y_h, same averaging
rule_A_algorithm.replace_if: challenger primary >= incumbent primary + 0.005 AND challenger guard >= incumbent guard
rule_A_algorithm.tie_break: if several challengers qualify, the largest primary gain wins

rule_B_horizon.applies_to: the algorithm selected by rule A
rule_B_horizon.metric_primary: user_recall@1%ufpr: attackers with an in-window alarm above the threshold at which 1% of benign dev users ever alarm (pooled out-of-fold scores per repeat, mean of 3 repeats)
guards: latency_median@1%ufpr (workdays from first injected day) <= default + 1
rule_B_horizon.replace_if: candidate primary >= default primary + 0.005 AND all guards hold
rule_B_horizon.tie_break: if both candidates qualify, the larger primary gain wins

later_stages_superseded.note: Original 2026-11-24 text, kept for transparency. Replaced by stage_B before any tuning or ablation was run (see stage_B.change_record).
later_stages_superseded.tuning_adoption: Optuna result adopted only if CV recall@1%fpr >= default + 0.005 AND PR-AUC >= default (selected h, dev CV)
later_stages_superseded.ablation_adoption: same rule as tuning; ablations that remove artifacts (C1) are documentation only and never adopted

change_record.status_at_registration: Stage A finished (rules A and B applied: lightgbm, y_10). No Optuna trial, no calibration, no ablation and no test score existed.
change_record.reason: Stage A audits (reports/audit_stageA.md, reports/audit_stageA2.md): row PR-AUC weights attackers by their positive rows (50-day windows 29.3% of y_10 positives, 5-day 5.3%) and hides the 5-day weakness (row PR-AUC 0.50 for 5-day vs 0.95 for 50-day). The objective is chosen for equal weight per attack duration with day-level timing kept, not for its score.
change_record.unchanged: split, labels, features, rule_A (lightgbm), rule_B (y_10), fixed 60/85 bands

stage_B.model: lightgbm, label y_10, the 100 predictors of the model dataset

definitions.duration_macro_row_pr_auc: For each attack duration d in {5,10,20,30,40,50}: average precision on y_10 over the rows of all benign users plus the attackers whose window_workdays = d, within the evaluation set. Objective = unweighted mean of the 6 values.
definitions.row_pr_auc: average precision on y_10 over all rows of the evaluation set
definitions.frozen_lfo_user_recall_1pct_superseded: SUPERSEDED by amendment_2 (the sibling-model scores depend on the validation fold). Original: for each validation fold, threshold = score exceeded by at most 1% of the peak scores of benign users in the OTHER folds of the same repeat; an attacker of this fold is detected if any in-window row scores above it. Recall over all dev attackers per repeat, mean of 3 repeats.
definitions.frozen_inner_user_recall_1pct: For outer fold (r, k) and a given arm (default or tuned): (1) the arm's configuration is trained on the 5 inner folds of the outer-train users only (nested_cv.per_outer_fold_tuning splits and early-stopping users); (2) each outer-train user's peak = max of its inner out-of-fold scores over the whole period; (3) threshold = threshold_at_fpr(benign outer-train peaks, 0.01), frozen; (4) the outer model of the same arm scores the outer-validation users; an attacker is detected if any in-window row scores above the frozen threshold. Recall = detected / all dev attackers, pooled over the 5 outer folds of a repeat, mean of 3 repeats. The realised false-positive count (benign outer-validation users whose peak exceeds the threshold) is reported for every outer fold.

amendment_2.status_at_amendment: no Optuna trial had been run
amendment_2.reason: Pre-flight check V3 (reports/stageB_preflight.md): the leave-fold-out threshold used OOF scores from sibling models, all of which were trained on the outer-validation users. Replaced by frozen_inner_user_recall_1pct, which uses only outer-train users and models trained only on them.
amendment_2.default_arm_cost: 5 inner default fits per outer fold (75 LightGBM fits); the tuned arm reuses the inner OOF of its best Optuna trial
amendment_2.caveat: inner models see about 80% of the outer-train users, so their score scale may differ slightly from the outer model; the realised FP count per outer fold is reported next to the recall

amendment_1.status_at_amendment: no Optuna trial had been run
amendment_1.reason: In the first registration, Optuna's inner CV and the 15-fold adoption comparison used the same 859 dev users, so the comparison would favour the tuned configuration (selection bias). Replaced by nested CV: Optuna never sees the users of the outer validation fold it is evaluated on.

nested_cv.outer_folds: the 15 folds of config/cv_folds.csv (repeat r in 0..2, fold k in 0..4); outer-train users = roles fit + es, outer-validation users = role valid
nested_cv.per_outer_fold_tuning: Optuna runs on the outer-train users ONLY. Inner CV = StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=142 + 10*r + k) on the outer-train users, groups and strata as in config/final_split.csv. Inside each inner-train set, early-stopping users = fold 0 of StratifiedGroupKFold(7, shuffle=True, random_state=1142 + 100*r + 10*k + inner_fold). Objective, sampler, trials, trial 0 and search space as in `optuna`.
nested_cv.per_outer_fold_evaluation: the best configuration of that outer fold is trained on the outer fit users with early stopping on the outer es users (exactly as in Stage A, seed 42 + r) and scores the outer-validation users, which Optuna never saw
nested_cv.default_arm: LightGBM defaults on the same outer folds, seeds and early-stopping users (the Stage A lightgbm y_10 OOF; recomputed and required to match)
nested_cv.nested_estimate: the tuned-procedure OOF scores (each validation row scored by its own outer fold's tuned model) are evaluated with the metrics in `definitions`, exactly as the default arm
nested_cv.reported: per outer fold: chosen parameters, inner objective of the best trial, inner objective of trial 0 (default), outer metrics; spread of the chosen parameters across the 15 folds
nested_cv.cost: 15 outer folds x 60 trials x 5 inner fits = 4,500 LightGBM fits plus 30 outer fits

optuna.data: dev users only; within nested CV, the outer-train users of each outer fold only
optuna.inner_cv: see nested_cv.per_outer_fold_tuning; for the final run (only if tuning is adopted): StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=142) on all 859 dev users, early-stopping users = fold 0 of StratifiedGroupKFold(7, shuffle=True, random_state=1142 + inner_fold)
optuna.objective: duration_macro_row_pr_auc computed ONCE on the pooled out-of-fold scores of the 5 inner folds, maximised
optuna.trial_0: the default configuration (models.LGBM_DEFAULTS) is enqueued as trial 0
optuna.no_reweighting: no class weights and no scale_pos_weight in the tuning search

tuning_adoption.evaluation: nested-CV tuned-procedure OOF vs default OOF on the same 15 outer folds (nested_cv)
tuning_adoption.primary: duration_macro_row_pr_auc on pooled OOF per repeat, mean of 3 repeats
tuning_adoption.if_adopted: run Optuna once on all 859 dev users (optuna.inner_cv final run) to obtain the final parameters. The expected performance reported for them is the nested estimate, never their own tuning score.

ablation_adoption.rule: same three conditions as tuning_adoption, comparing the ablated variant with the adopted Stage B configuration on the 15 outer folds
ablation_adoption.documentation_only: the C1 companion-column variant (artifact documentation) is never adopted, whatever its scores

calibration.method: Platt scaling risk = 100 * sigmoid(a * logit(p) + b)
calibration.fit_data: out-of-fold scores of the adopted configuration on the 15 outer folds, all 3 repeats stacked (each dev row 3 times), row level, target y_10. Default adopted: the Stage A lightgbm y_10 OOF. Tuned adopted: the final parameters re-run on the 15 outer folds (their scores are slightly optimistic because the parameters were chosen on all dev users; this is documented).
calibration.reported: a, b per repeat in addition to the stacked fit, to show stability
calibration.meaning: Layer 1 only: calibrated daily P(at least one injected attack day in the last 10 workdays | features at t) under the dev population mix; not a per-employee probability

stage_B.final_fit: refit on all dev users with the mean best-iteration count of the 15 outer folds
stage_B.test_protocol: test opened once, after the final fit; every threshold frozen from dev (fixed 60/85 bands and the dev 1% user-FPR threshold on the risk scale); FP counts out of 84 benign test users reported with exact CIs; no decision is changed after test scores are seen
